messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 502/504 at api-gateway.edge across us-west-2 -> error rate ~38% over 5m. paging @jen-oncall and @alex-sre :rotating_light:
jen-oncall: on it, joining channel now. any obvious rollout?
alex-sre: I see a sharp jump at 6312349500 in gateway proxy layer. upstream timeouts and connection resets to inference-pool-A, not pure 5xx from backend. graph: https://dash.internal/r/edge/errs?tz=UTC (shortlink)
sam-runtime: confirmed. conn resets + queued requests per worker rising. CPU on gateway nodes normal, sockets exhausted on upstream side.
jen-oncall: hypothesis: client prefix cache warmed down -> thundering congestion hitting upstream connection pool. this started ~10m after a config push to routing rules. lucy-product, any traffic changes?
lucy-product: no product change this window, but we did flip a traffic-split on experiment X at 6312349200 earlier today. could be related.
alex-sre: quick mitigation: enable ingress circuit-breaker for route /api/v1/generate to failfast and short-circuit heavy requests. also temporarily cap concurrent requests to inference-pool-A.
jen-oncall: sam, can you apply a quick knob? if not, we can reroute traffic to inference-pool-B in eu-west as fallback.
sam-runtime: running command to set cb and cap now:
```
# set circuit breaker and concurrency cap
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/routes/ingress/circuitbreaker \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/api/v1/generate","concurrency":8,"timeout_ms":2000}'
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: controlplane-route-update-2026-03-17T12:45Z (id: cp-9302)
deploy-bot: deploy success: circuit-breaker applied to /api/v1/generate (cp-9302)
alex-sre: also throttled downstream to inference-pool-A at edge-proxy, reduced fanout. command: `edgectl throttle --pool inference-pool-A --rate 200r/s`
ops-bot: throttle command executed by alex-sre at 6312349805
maria-support: customer-impact: Support queue has 18 tickets referencing 502s in last 20m, top customer a-omni saw 35% errors. adding sample req-id: req_0a9f2c. notifying premium customers.
jen-oncall: good call. I'm shifting 30% of traffic to inference-pool-B eu-west as fallback. starting traffic-shift now.
alex-sre: rolling restart of a couple upstream pods that had stale connections: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-upstream-A -n edge` (doing now)
sam-runtime: after circuit-breaker + throttles + small traffic-shift, error rate trending down: 38% -> 9% in 4m. latency for successful reqs stable.
jen-oncall: keep monitoring. ops-bot, set a 1hr follow-up reminder for postmortem and assign to eng-runtime + eng-infra.
ops-bot: Reminder set: postmortem-runbook @eng-runtime @eng-infra in 1h (trigger id: rem-4412).
lucy-product: raising customer comms draft in #incidents-updates, will coordinate with maria-support.
amaz: (typo message, ignore)
jen-oncall: handoff to alex for containment -> alex, please lead next steps for root cause and remediation. I'll stay for customer comms for next 30m.
alex-sre: ack, taking lead. will collect traces, socket metrics, and routing diff from 6312349000-6312349800. posting updates here. :thumbsup:
sam-runtime: adding a note: consider increasing upstream connection pool and adding short-lived KV cache for prefixes to avoid recurrence.
jen-oncall: thanks team. leaving channel in 25m. update in 10.
